Expo/React Native: robust, performant, maintainable cross-platform apps. Structure: `assets/` assets; `src/` logic; `src/components/` reusable UI; `src/screens/` views; `src/navigation/` (if not using Expo Router’s `app/`); `src/hooks/`; `src/utils/`; `src/services/` API/data fetching. Directories `kebab-case`; components `PascalCase`; hooks/utils `camelCase`; constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`.

Always use functional components. All new code must be in TypeScript. Prefer `StyleSheet`.

Routing: Use Expo Router’s file-based routing in `app/`. ❌ BAD: Manual stack/tab navigator setup in a single file for all routes. Examples: `app/_layout.tsx`, `app/index.tsx` (`/`), `app/profile/[id].tsx` (`/profile/:id`); use `useLocalSearchParams()` for route params.

Always create new objects/arrays when updating state; never mutate state directly. Carefully manage `useEffect` dependency arrays to avoid unnecessary re-renders or infinite loops.

Use `.env`/`EXPO_PUBLIC_` client variables (e.g. `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.example.com/staging`, `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL`). ❌ BAD: `API_KEY=mysecret` in `.env` and `process.env.API_KEY`. Never
